status: draft: instrument built, smoke run, under pre-freeze review

design.question: Does the headline recipe (0014's searched HGB M4, 0.2884 in distribution) identify the encoder at chance + 0.05 on eight content families the corpus builder never produced, when fitted on the builder's 800000-row pool? 0003's incumbent M1 and 0014's standardised logistic L3 beside it as flags.
design.why_now: 0015, 0016 and 0017 measured transfer only among the builder's own families (seven parametric generators sharing one syllable vocabulary, one Gutenberg family); the headline recipe M4 was never fitted under transfer; no model in the record has ever been scored outside the builder. This is the buyer's question in its strongest form the record can currently afford: content nobody manufactured for this record.

extension_corpus.builder: tools/pivot/corpus_ext.py (imports corpus.py's CONFIGS/compress/carve and features.py unchanged)
extension_corpus.determinism_probe: corpus_ext.py --probe: 3 chunks per family built twice in two task orders, identical arrays (2026-09-09 23:00 UTC)
extension_corpus.sources: tools/pivot/ext_source_pins.json (82 files pinned by sha256; fetched 2026-09-09 22:55 UTC by tools/pivot/fetch_ext_sources.sh); licences in docs/compliance/EXT_SOURCES.md
extension_corpus.why_non_overlapping_chunks: the audit found gutenberg's random offsets let evaluation windows overlap; the extension cuts consecutive chunks and picks by seeded permutation without replacement
extension_corpus.why_own_chunk_id_space_and_fam_array: the builder's family rule is FAMILIES[chunk_id % 8]; the extension's ids start at 10000000 and its family is an explicit array so no reader can confuse the two

design.fits: M1 (0003's incumbent, val frag), L3 (0014's, standardised), M4 (0014's searched, val frag), each once on the sealed pool (hash 17b0dc0b...); null: M4 on the first 20000 pool rows with shuffled labels; every fit scored once on [sealed evaluation rows; extension rows] through run_recipe_search.run_fit unchanged, so the record's top1 is over the concatenation and the readings are split by index range (banked under `readings`, recomputed by the reader)
design.clause: M4's correct extension rows >= ceil(n_ext x (1/26 + 0.05)) = 5433 of 61409 -> OOB_TRANSFERS else OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS; validity: reproductions within 0.005 of 0.2395 / 0.2317 / 0.2884, null <= chance + 0.02 on the extension rows, sealed hashes, one scoring per fit, readings arithmetic
flags_not_clauses: L3 and M1 at the same bar
M4 minus L3 and M4 minus M1 as exact counts, and whether each reaches 0.05
per-family readings, structured-text / high-entropy / real / synthetic subsets
per-family ceilings (distinct carved fragments among the 26 configurations)
design.expected_outcome: see prereg scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: prior close to even

cost_anchors.estimate: about 5.4 h of fit plus scoring of 321409 rows per fit; MemAvailable must be >= 14.5 GB at launch

smoke_runs.invocation: --smoke with top_rung 12000, fit_rows 10000, null_rows 2000, a 5-chunk-per-family extension build (1040 rows) sealed in smoke.ext_corpus; outputs under the scratchpad
smoke_runs.what_it_checked: the runner's refusals, the extension seal, the concatenated scoring, the readings split, checkpoints and the artifact/scores layout; the reader was then exercised end to end on this output with its pool, null and extension literals patched to the smoke's (scratchpad script reader_on_smoke_0018.py)
smoke_runs.note: a 10000-row fit cannot reproduce the full-pool references and the reader voids it; the numbers above are from tiny fits and say nothing about the preregistered question

operator_procedure: launch detached (setsid nohup) with the sealed invocation after the freeze; keep the session active for the whole run (an idle session suspends the runner and the container restarts on the next wake: 0016's finding); poll every 30 minutes: commit and push new checkpoints, relaunch the identical command if the runner is dead and the run is not finished; the reader runs once on the completed artifact; publication states the verdict at the same size either way.
